dialog: This might work.
This time/ I have back-up!
I'll mute all sound and launch a sneak attack...
I can't let Sunny hog all the glory!
I guess I should attack back...
Y-You won't beat me!
I should have seen this coming...
Maybe I can distract them with some danmaku and run away.
I might be able to hit now!
If we attack together/ maybe—!
It's time for our special attack.
Here I cooome.
Uhmm... Haaah.
It's make-or-break!
I'm not going down without a fight.
Haaah.
Hyaaah.
Do me a favor and get hit/ alright?
These better hit.
I'll get you!
Hyah!
Girls/ help me out!
Alright/ alright. Are you ready?
Ready when you are.
The three of us together can do anything!
Let's do this. Now!
Sunny/ Star! Help me out!
Okay! Let's use our formation attack.
Sunny/ you take point.\n　Luna/ you take point too.
Somehow/ that doesn't seem right.
Oh/ who cares? Ka-BLOOM!
Sunny/ Star! Get in formation!
Let's switch things up a bit.
How about we have Luna kick us off?
Huh? You mean/ I have to say the thing?
Ka... Ka-bloom.\n　Ugh/ it's so cringe!
Sunny/ Star/ let's do that thing!
Hey/ that thing" has a proper name!
Oh/ I just completely forgot about it.
Who cares what it's called/ as long as it works?
Attack names are cool/ though...\n　Oh well. Here we go!
Girls/ give me a hand!
I think Luna should lead the attack this time.
Are you sure? You know how much of a klutz she is.
...Well/ excuse me.
C'mon/ let's do this!
Eeep! Girls/ I need help!
Oh/ Luna. You're such a klutz.
Well/ excuse me—\n　Hold on/ this has nothing to do with my clumsiness!
Can we get a move on/ Sunny?
Right. Here goes nothin'!
You asked for it.
Girls/ it's time for our LFA sequence.
L is for... Light!
A is for... Attack!
Staaar! I have to say the A! You're supposed to—\n　Awww/ we're out of time!
You asked for it.
Girls/ it's time for our LFA sequence.
L—Last night/ I hid...
F—From everyone/ and...
A—Ate all the cookies in the jar.\n　Wait/ what's with the comedy routine?
You asked for it.
Girls/ time for our patented LFA sequence.
L—Light Fairies are three.
F—Four of them would be...
A—A headache.\n　Wait/ that sounds wrong...
How long can I keep this up?
This'll work out in the end/ right...?
This isn't working out!
I don't even know where they are.\n　What am I supposed to do?
You know... I'm starting to think that maybe/\n　just maybe... we should be running away.
I guess I'll tag along.
Let me help.
W-Wait! Don't lead them my way!
Err/ I guess I'm covering you?
I hope I'm not in your way...
Uhmm/ I'll try to keep up.
Well/ I hope I can help.
I'll stay here and shoot. That's helping/ right?
Let me help!
If we attack together/ I may even hit something!
I'm so pumped right now/ I might even sneak in a good hit.
My danmaku's no joke!
I'll use my ability to help you!
Rumia! You... You protected me?!
I'll sneak in while Rumia keeps them busy!
Let me help/ Rumia!
Err... Why am I defending Rumia/ again?
Rumia/ please stay focused!
Let me help/ Rumia!
Don't forget about your power/ Rumia!
Let's go/ Rumia!
I'm with you/ Rumia!
I'll back you up. You finish the job/ Rumia!
Rumia's doing her best! I won't let her down!
Rumia! I'll use my ability to help you!
Rumia! I'll use my best danmaku!
Dai... I'm so sorry...
I'll sneak in while Dai keeps them busy!
Let me help/ Dai!
Don't you dare hurt our Dai!
Dai! Watch out!
Together/ we can do this!
We'll get them/ somehow!
Let me help/ Dai!
I'm with you/ Dai!
Let's go/ Dai!
Dai! Let's show them what we fairies can really do!
Dai! I'll use my ability to help you!
Dai! I'll use my best danmaku!
Cirno?! You... You protected me?!
I'll sneak in while Cirno keeps them busy!
Cirno/ let me help!
Oh/ Cirno. Always the reckless one.
Cirno/ could you please focus once in a while?
I'll try to keep up/ Cirno!
Let's go/ Cirno!
Cirno/ let me help!
I'm with you/ Cirno!
I'll back you up. You finish the job/ Cirno!
Cirno's doing her best! I won't let her down!
Cirno! Let's show them what we fairies can really do!
Cirno! I'll use my best danmaku!
Don't say I didn't warn you.
Thanks for distracting them/ Sunny!
Sunny/ let me help!
Don't forget about your power/ Sunny!
Sunnyyy! Stay focuseeed!
I'd better stick close to her...
I'll back you up. You'd better not miss/ Sunny!
You won't be calling me a klutz this time!
Let's go/ Sunny!
I'm with you/ Sunny!
Don't forget about your power/ Sunny!
Sunny/ let me help!
Sunny's doing her best! I won't let her down!
Sunny! Let's show them what we fairies can really do!
Sunny! I'll use my best danmaku!
Uhm/ Star/ that doesn't look good—\n　...Aaand/ she's gone.
I should be fine if I go after Star/ right?
Star/ let me help!
Staaar! You can't just stand there!
Star? Why aren't you moving away from—\n　Wait/ it's coming THIS way?!
Let's do this/ Star!
You'd better fight too/ Star! Don't leave me hanging!
Don't forget about your power/ Star!
Moon and stars go pretty well together/ don't they?
Please pick up my slack if I miss/ okay?
I'm with you/ Star!
Star/ let me help!
Star's doing her best! I won't let her down!
Star! Let's show them what we fairies can really do!
Star! I'll use my best danmaku!
Alice! Are you okay?
You know... I think we got this backwards.
Next time/ get Dai to protect you.
This is straight-up fairy abuse!
Let's combine our lunar powers!
Let me assist you/ Lunasa!
Focus/ Luna. Don't mute the Prismrivers' sound.
She sure is cheerful/ but I won't be out-cheered!
Let me assist you/ Merlin!
Focus/ Luna. Don't mute the Prismrivers' sound.
I'd better not mess up the performance of the main musician...
Let me assist you/ Lyrica!
Focus/ Luna. Don't mute the Prismrivers' sound.
Oww...
Ugh. I knew I'd end up getting hurt.
Eeek!
Did they sense my presence/ even without sound...?!
Why is this happening?!
But I muted all sound! How did you find me?!
Yeah/ I figured you'd go for me...
Owww! That hurt!
Good thing I brought my helmet...
D-Did it miss?
I dodged now/ but who knows if I'll be so lucky next time...
That was way too close for comfort.
Hey/ watch it!
There's no way I'm holding out for long...
Eeek!\n　...Wait/ that didn't hurt.
I'll mute all sound and attack before they're ready!
Awww... I knew I couldn't do it...
That's about what I expected...
R-Run awaaay!
This is all your fault/ Sunny!
Those dangerous women are too tall.\n　We're the perfect size.
I won't back down from a fight/ Dai!
Those dangerous women are too tall.\n　We're the perfect size.
I'm ready to fight/ Rumia!
Those dangerous women are too tall.\n　We're the perfect size.
We'll see who's the strongest fairy/ Cirno!
How do you even fight a god?\n　Is this going to do anything?
We need to keep fighting.\n　For Utsuho's sake.
Can we make this quick? I want to see the bazaar.
I guess this is the game you want to play today.
Can we make this quick? I want to see the bazaar.
I guess this is the game you want to play today.
